messages:
alex: Heads-up — thinking about a small, low-friction improvement to deploy tooling: add an inline "annotate+pin" flow in the deploy bot so PMs/ENG can attach a tiny rollout note and a rollback reason that persists with the pin. We get clearer release notes and faster rollback context. Thoughts?

tia: love this. main ask: make it optional and tiny. we already have long changelog workflows, don't want to force it. maybe flags like --note "short summary" and --tag rollback:reason

sam: +1. also add a --dry-run that prints the pin id and the final payload so we can paste into release tickets. current manual paste step is the slow point.

deploy-bot: @alex thanks — example CLI proposal:```/deploy --model=redwood-v2 --env=prod --pin --note="cache fix for search" --change-window="2026-03-22T02:00Z/02:30Z"```bot response: "Pinned v2@sha1234 -> pin_id=pin_20260322_7f9. Use /deploy rollback pin_20260322_7f9 --reason=... to rollback."

maria: can we make the note synced to the release-notes template so when we export release notes the short note is included under the route? small JSON payload in the pin record would do it.

tia: also, sensible defaults: if no --change-window, tag pin as "immediate" and send to #oncall for ack. if change-window provided, schedule auto-unpin check after window.

sam: rollback decision guidance idea: bot should capture a metric snapshot (error rate, p95 latency) at pin time and at T+5/15/30 and include a short auto-summary. then the oncall can decide faster. minimal: just collect p50/p95/error-rate and a delta.

jeff: (react) :thumbsup:

jon: calendar integration: when a change-window is provided with a calendar id, bot should block that time in releases calendar and add the pin id to the event. helps ops and comms. low-fi option: post a pinned message in #release-schedule with the details.

opsbot: implemented prototype for auto-snapshot collectors earlier this year — can be wired to deploy-bot. sample snapshot payload:```{"p50_ms":"120","p95_ms":"420","error_rate":"0.3%","requests":"1200"}```. we should standardize naming.

maria: release-note template suggestion: one liner, impact, migration (if any), rollback trigger. e.g.:
- Summary: Short sentence
- Impact: Who/what might be affected
- Rollback trigger: exact metric to watch and threshold
- Owner: @handle

alex: perfect. let's keep the flags compact: --note, --rollback-trigger, --owner, --change-window. default dry-run prints payload JSON. implementation plan: tia + sam prototype bot flags + dry-run, opsbot hook for snapshots, jon will do calendar integration, maria will wire release-note export.

tia: I can sketch the CLI->payload mapping today. sample dry-run output:```{
  "pin_id": "dry_pin_xyz",
  "model": "redwood-v2",
  "note": "cache fix for search",
  "rollback_trigger": "p95>500ms || error_rate>1%",
  "owner": "@maria",
  "change_window": "2026-03-22T02:00Z/02:30Z"
}```

sam: I'll add the quick rollback helper: `/deploy rollback <pin_id> --reason "ops cut" --force` that performs safety checks and calls the rollback playbook. default path requires two approvals if the pin is > X traffic.

deploy-bot: prototype ack: created a sandbox route: `/deploy --help` now lists --note/--rollback-trigger/--owner/--change-window/--dry-run. Trying it in #deploy-sandbox.

maria: agree on approvals. for high-traffic pins, require a canary check and either 2 approvers or an escalation to SRE lead. we should add that threshold to the pin metadata (traffic_pct).

alex: ok action items and owners (high-level):
- tia + sam: CLI flags + dry-run + quick rollback helper (ETA: 3 days)
- opsbot + sam: snapshot hook + standard metric payload (ETA: 1 week)
- jon: calendar or #release-schedule integration (ETA: 2 days)
- maria: release-note export template + include pin metadata (ETA: 3 days)

jon: I'll create the release-schedule event pattern and a small spec for calendar webhook.

tia: I'll open a tiny RFC in docs/ with examples and the proposed CLI syntax.

sam: ping me for pairing on the rollback approvals logic.

alex: thanks all — if no objections I'll have tia open the RFC and a repo with a minimal bot patch. goal: reduce manual paste steps and make rollbacks faster with better context. :rocket:
